answers.core: This functionality is a fundamental string inspection primitive, not application-level logic and similar validation-related helpers already exist in core (is_valid_int, is_valid_identifier, etc.)
answers.workaround: Yes, it is possible to work around this limitation with a few lines of script. However, this proposal is not primarily about reducing line count but about providing a correct, consistent and expressive core API for a very common operation.

title: Add character class inspection methods to String (uppercase, lowercase, digit, special)
